ns0:svg.ns0:title: MIGRO system overview
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Observed experience enters through a source-host writer. A persistent state carries evidence payloads and semantic addresses. Transport and calibration connect that state to receiving Qwen, Phi and Mistral hosts. Diagram shows the reference architecture; selected modules are released.

ns0:g.aria-label: THE STATE TRAVELS. THE INTERFACE ADAPTS.
Persistent experience and host-specific readout have separate lifetimes.
Reference architecture. Released code covers selected components; see implementation scope.
